captions.detailed: This 3D model features a heavy-duty downhill bicycle crankset with a wide, dark grey bottom-bracket shell. It includes a large black outer bash-guard ring, two thick light-grey aluminum crank arms positioned 180 degrees apart, and two flat black platform pedals. The crank arms and bash-guard assembly rotate continuously relative to the fixed bottom-bracket shell, while each pedal rotates freely on its respective pedal axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a downhill freeride crankset. The model should include a wide bottom-bracket spindle shell, a large circular outer bash guard, two thick aluminum crank arms, and two rectangular platform pedals. Ensure continuous rotational joints are defined for the spindle rotation and the individual pedal rotations.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a fixed bottom-bracket shell using cylindrical primitives. It then models the rotating spindle, crank arms, and circular bash-guard as a single rigid part. The crank arms are formed by lofting or combining cylinders and boxes, and the bash-guard is composed of concentric rings. The platform pedals are constructed from flat boxes with cylindrical spindle attachments. Finally, continuous articulations are defined to allow the spindle/crank assembly to rotate relative to the shell, and each pedal to rotate relative to its crank arm.
